papers.title: Numerical Simulation and Experimental Study of Millisecond Percussion Drilling in Titanium Alloy
papers.abstract: This study addresses the challenge of drilling film-cooling holes in the turbine blades of aircraft engines. Titanium alloy TC4 was selected as the experimental material. The laser-drilling process was simulated with ANSYS to determine optimal parameters, which were subsequently applied in machining trials. An impact-drilling method was then used to evaluate how pulse width, pulse energy, and pulse count affect micro-hole entrance and exit diameters, taper, and roundness. Simulations revealed that pulse energy and pulse count predominantly govern entrance and exit diameters, whereas pulse count and pulse width exert a stronger influence on taper. Experiments confirmed that entrance and exit diameters increased as pulse energy rose from 2.0 J to 2.8 J; taper increased as pulse width widened from 0.6 ms to 1.4 ms; and entrance diameter, exit diameter, and taper all grew as pulse count rose from 40 to 60. Pulse width and pulse count also significantly affected hole roundness.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究钛合金激光钻孔工艺，不涉及增材制造后处理或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: No additive manufacturing context, no post-processing treatment (e.g., heat treatment, HIP, surface modification) applied to AM Ti-6Al-4V, and no evaluation of fatigue or mechanical performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化航空发动机涡轮叶片气膜冷却孔的激光钻孔参数。
summary_zh.method: 采用ANSYS仿真与实验结合研究脉冲参数对微孔质量的影响。
summary_zh.result: 脉冲能量和次数主导孔径，脉冲宽度和次数影响锥度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验验证仿真得到的参数影响规律。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize laser drilling parameters for film-cooling holes in aircraft engine turbine blades made of titanium alloy TC4.
summary_en.method: Numerical simulations using ANSYS and experimental percussive drilling were employed to study the effects of pulse width, energy, and count on hole geometry.
summary_en.result: Pulse energy and count primarily control entrance and exit diameters, while pulse width and count strongly influence taper and roundness.
summary_en.validation: Experimental drilling trials confirmed the simulation predictions for parameter effects on hole dimensions and shape.
